record.body: Durable learning: once a reusable independent consumer court and evidence-return loop exist, the next production-function bottleneck is not more verifier logic but explicit producer-owned consumer admission law. Readiness must be separated from inherited ALIVE standing. Canonical admission semantics plus executable readiness/falsifier courts make adapter fanout selectable without fabricating compatibility. R51 proved 55 meaningful transitions can convert one remembered weak multiplier into a reusable admission compiler and a concrete downstream adapter frontier while keeping 1000X NOT_ADMITTED until replay-verified consumer evidence exists.
